low.title: Low
low.description: Inclusive low bound of the integer range.

high.title: High
high.description: Inclusive high bound. Must be >= low.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.description: Optional 32-byte hex pre-commitment from the caller. Included in the signed payload, so the server cannot have chosen the result after seeing the caller's downstream intent.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional caller-defined tag (e.g. 'treasure_drop_42'). Included verbatim in the signed payload.
